text: Court watch: amended petition names Victoria Irene Simmons as surviving spouse, not daughter.

Florida homestead with a surviving spouse: she takes a life estate, or elects a one-half interest as tenant in common (s. 732.401). Either way, she must sign the deed. heirs.md updated: the signer set is the spouse plus the two descendants, after the homestead order.
Risk file updated: spouse election deadline and her signature are now closing requirements; the contract names her as a seller. Price and terms unchanged.
Offer letter addressed to all three by name and role (spouse and two children); she's the one who wanted to list, so the honest listing comparison matters even more.
